newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen down.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.02 down at 40.90 to the dollar on Monday on fresh dollar demand and dealers said the rupee would dip further soon.
"There has been enough downside for the dollar in the kerb. Now it will bounce back," dealer Owais Kalia said. The rupee has gained 0.42 to 40.92 against the dollar in the past week.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended at 2.75 percent, down from previous opening at 2.80. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
